                        ELSE (p.received_units - COALESCE(sold.total_sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(waste.total_waste_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                    END
                ) as total_value
                FROM purchases p
                LEFT JOIN (
                    /* Sum all sales for this purchase */
                    SELECT s.purchase_id, 
                           SUM(COALESCE(s.weight_kg, s.weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(s.returned_kg, 0)) as total_sold_kg,
                           SUM(s.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.returned_units, 0)) as total_sold_units
                    FROM sales s
                    WHERE s.is_returned = 0 AND s.purchase_id IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY s.purchase_id
                ) sold ON p.id = sold.purchase_id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    /* Sum all waste/dropped items for this purchase */
                    SELECT purchase_id, 
                           SUM(weight_kg) as total_waste_kg,
                           SUM(quantity_units) as total_waste_units
                    FROM leftovers 
                    WHERE status IN ('Dropped', 'Auto_Dropped') AND purchase_id IS NOT NULL
                    GROUP BY purchase_id
                ) waste ON p.id = waste.purchase_id
                WHERE p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi', 'Completed') | []

                    (COALESCE(s.total_revenue, 0) - (p.net_cost - p.discount_amount)) as net_profit
                FROM purchases p
                JOIN providers pr ON p.provider_id = pr.id
                JOIN qat_types qt ON p.qat_type_id = qt.id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT purchase_id, SUM(price) as total_revenue, SUM(weight_grams/1000) as sold_kg
                    FROM sales 
                    WHERE is_returned = 0
                    GROUP BY purchase_id
                ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as waste_kg
                    FROM leftovers
                    WHERE status IN ('Dropped', 'Auto_Dropped')
                    GROUP BY purchase_id
                ) w ON p.id = w.purchase_id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as remaining_kg
                    FROM leftovers
                    WHERE status NOT IN ('Dropped', 'Auto_Dropped')
                    GROUP BY purchase_id
                ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                WHERE YEAR(p.purchase_date) = ?
                ORDER BY p.purchase_date DESC | ["2026"]

                    p.expected_quantity_kg,

                    (p.expected_quantity_kg - p.quantity_kg) as shortage_kg,
                    (p.net_cost - p.discount_amount) as total_cost,
                    COALESCE(s.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue,
                    COALESCE(s.fresh_kg, 0) as fresh_kg,
                    COALESCE(s.momsi1_kg, 0) as momsi1_kg,
                    COALESCE(s.momsi2_kg, 0) as momsi2_kg,
                    COALESCE(w.waste_kg, 0) as waste_kg,
                    COALESCE(l.remaining_kg, 0) as remaining_kg,
                    (COALESCE(s.total_revenue, 0) - (p.net_cost - p.discount_amount)) as net_profit
                FROM purchases p
                JOIN providers pr ON p.provider_id = pr.id
                JOIN qat_types qt ON p.qat_type_id = qt.id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT 
                        s.purchase_id, 
                        SUM(s.price) as total_revenue,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN s.qat_status = 'Tari' THEN s.weight_grams/1000 ELSE 0 END) as fresh_kg,

                    FROM sales s
                    LEFT JOIN leftovers l ON s.leftover_id = l.id
                    WHERE s.is_returned = 0
                    GROUP BY s.purchase_id
                ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id

                        WHEN s.leftover_id IS NOT NULL THEN 
                            (CASE WHEN s.unit_type = 'weight' THEN ((s.weight_grams/1000 - COALESCE(s.returned_kg, 0)) * pl.price_per_kilo) ELSE ((s.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.returned_units, 0)) * pl.price_per_unit) END)
                        ELSE 0 
                    END
                ) as total_cost
                FROM sales s
                LEFT JOIN purchases p ON s.purchase_id = p.id
                LEFT JOIN leftovers l ON s.leftover_id = l.id

10:13:12 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((

                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l

                ), 0)

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

10:19:10 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)

                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units

                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

                ), 0)

                            ELSE

                            ELSE

                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id

                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units

                            ELSE

                        END

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)

                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE

                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id

                        SELECT leftover_id,

                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units

                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

                ), 0)

10:25:42 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

10:31:56 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)

                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

11:20:22 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE

                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)

                        CASE

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,

                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

15:26:19 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

15:26:44 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

01:20:55 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)

                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (

                ), 0)

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

06:11:40 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[2] | Rows[0] | SELECT p.id as purchase_id, 
                       (COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) + COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) as sold_kg, 
                       (COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) + COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) as sold_units 
                FROM purchases p
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT purchase_id, 
                           SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg, 
                           SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units 
                    FROM sales 
                    WHERE is_returned = 0 AND purchase_id IS NOT NULL 
                    GROUP BY purchase_id
                ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                    FROM leftovers 
                    WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss'
                    GROUP BY purchase_id
                ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                WHERE (s.purchase_id IS NOT NULL OR l.purchase_id IS NOT NULL) AND p.purchase_date = ? GROUP BY p.id | ["2026-05-10"]
