            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

21:58:13 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[1] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

22:11:14 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[1] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

22:28:57 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[1] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

22:29:22 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[1] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

23:53:10 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id,

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id,

                ), 0)

00:05:33 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

09:42:18 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

09:42:47 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

09:52:07 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units

                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')

                            ELSE

                        END
                    )

09:53:47 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

09:53:49 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

10:02:59 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

10:14:56 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((

                        CASE

                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (

                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,

                ), 0)

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)

                        CASE

                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id

                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

10:37:38 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id

10:39:16 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((

                        CASE

                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id

                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE

                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id,

                ), 0)

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)

                        CASE

                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units

                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id

10:40:14 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
