19:00:15 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

19:08:05 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

19:10:48 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * p.price_per_kilo
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * p.price_per_unit
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

19:30:34 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

20:10:30 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

20:14:12 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

16:38:12 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id

                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

16:38:23 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p

16:40:51 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                                    ((s.weight_grams/1000 - COALESCE(s.returned_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))) 
                                ELSE 
                                    ((s.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.returned_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0)))

                            (CASE 
                                WHEN s.unit_type = 'weight' THEN

                            END)
                        ELSE 0 
                    END
                ) as total_cost
                FROM sales s

                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

09:21:02 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                        CASE

                        END

                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units

                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN

                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers

                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)

                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,

                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id

                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []

09:41:15 | TX[NO] | Level[0] | PDO[3] | Rows[1] | 
            SELECT (
                -- 1. Value of Fresh Purchases (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN p.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (p.quantity_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (p.received_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0) - COALESCE(l.leftover_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM purchases p
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) s ON p.id = s.purchase_id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT purchase_id, SUM(weight_kg) as leftover_kg, SUM(quantity_units) as leftover_units
                        FROM leftovers 
                        WHERE status != 'Reception_Loss' 
                        GROUP BY purchase_id
                    ) l ON p.id = l.purchase_id
                    WHERE p.is_received = 1 AND p.status IN ('Fresh', 'Momsi')
                ), 0)
                +
                -- 2. Value of Active Leftovers (unsold portion)
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(
                        CASE 
                            WHEN l.unit_type = 'weight' THEN 
                                (l.weight_kg - COALESCE(s.sold_kg, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.quantity_kg, 0))
                            ELSE 
                                (l.quantity_units - COALESCE(s.sold_units, 0)) * ((p.agreed_price - p.discount_amount) / NULLIF(p.received_units, 0))
                        END
                    )
                    FROM leftovers l
                    JOIN purchases p ON l.purchase_id = p.id
                    LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT leftover_id, 
                               SUM(COALESCE(weight_kg, weight_grams/1000) - COALESCE(returned_kg, 0)) as sold_kg,
                               SUM(quantity_units - COALESCE(returned_units, 0)) as sold_units
                        FROM sales WHERE leftover_id IS NOT NULL AND is_returned = 0 GROUP BY leftover_id
                    ) s ON l.id = s.leftover_id
                    WHERE l.status IN ('Transferred_Next_Day', 'Auto_Momsi', 'Momsi_Day_1', 'Momsi_Day_2')
                ), 0)
            ) as total_value | []
